evidence.reason: The writer uses recursive mkdir for `observations/<workId>`, so if `journalDir` (or an ancestor) is absent it is created by this call. The fsync sequence persists `streamDir`, `observations/`, and `journalDir`, but not the parent directory entry that makes a newly created `journalDir` durable. A crash can therefore drop the new `journalDir` and its stream contents despite `persistence: 'durable'`. This is an implementation durability defect in existing behavior; the caller-contract alternative is a possible design choice, not the only fix.
